name: Certified Organic by ECOCERT
description: This certification is awarded by ECOCERT to agricultural products grown and processed without the use of synthetic fertilizers, pesticides, or genetically modified organisms. Farms must comply with strict organic production standards and undergo regular inspections.

name: Protected Designation of Origin (PDO)
description: PDO certifies that a product is produced, processed, and prepared in a specific geographical area, using recognized know-how. It ensures the uniqueness and authenticity of regional products such as cheeses, wines, and olive oils.

name: Fair Trade Certified
description: Products bearing this certification meet rigorous social, environmental, and economic standards, ensuring fair wages and safe working conditions for farmers and workers, as well as sustainable farming practices.

name: Rainforest Alliance Certified
description: This certification indicates that the product was produced on farms that meet comprehensive standards for environmental, social, and economic sustainability, including biodiversity conservation and natural resource protection.

name: GlobalG.A.P. Certified
description: GlobalG.A.P. is an internationally recognized set of farm standards dedicated to Good Agricultural Practices (G.A.P.). This certification ensures food safety, environmental sustainability, and worker welfare throughout the agricultural supply chain.

name: Non-GMO Project Verified
description: This certification verifies that the product has been produced according to rigorous best practices for GMO avoidance, including testing of risk ingredients and ongoing facility inspections.

name: Certified Naturally Grown
description: A grassroots alternative to certified organic, this label is given to small-scale farmers who use natural, ecological farming methods without synthetic chemicals, verified through peer inspections.

name: Carbon Neutral Farm Certification
description: This certification is awarded to farms that have achieved net zero carbon emissions through sustainable practices, renewable energy use, and verified carbon offset initiatives.

name: Animal Welfare Approved
description: This certification is given to independent family farms that raise animals according to the highest welfare standards, including access to pasture, humane treatment, and prohibition of routine antibiotics or growth hormones.

name: Demeter Biodynamic Certification
description: Demeter certifies that agricultural products are produced using biodynamic methods, which go beyond organic by focusing on holistic, ecological, and ethical approaches to farming, including specific soil and compost preparations.

name: Sustainably Grown Certified
description: This certification ensures that crops are farmed using sustainable agricultural practices, protecting the environment, preserving biodiversity, and supporting the welfare of workers and local communities.

name: USDA Organic
description: This certification from the United States Department of Agriculture guarantees that products are produced without synthetic fertilizers, sewage sludge, irradiation, and genetic engineering, following strict organic farming regulations.

name: Local Harvest Certified
description: Products with this label are grown, harvested, and processed within a specific local region, supporting local economies, reducing food miles, and ensuring product freshness and traceability.

name: Integrated Pest Management (IPM) Certified
description: This certification recognizes farms that implement IPM strategies, combining biological, cultural, and physical methods to control pests, minimizing pesticide use and reducing environmental impact.

name: Certified Regenerative Organic
description: This certification is awarded to farms that follow regenerative practices beyond organic, such as crop rotation, cover cropping, reduced tillage, and animal welfare measures, aiming to rebuild soil health and ecosystem resilience.

name: Rainforest Alliance Certified
description: This certification ensures that farms meet rigorous environmental, social, and economic standards, including ecosystem conservation, wildlife protection, fair labor practices, and efficient farm management.

name: Fair for Life Social & Fair Trade Certified

name: GlobalG.A.P. Certified

name: Protected Designation of Origin (PDO) Certified

name: Certified Grass-Fed

name: Soil Association Organic Certified

name: Certified Water Stewardship

description: This certification ensures that farm products are produced under fair labor conditions, with fair wages, safe working environments, and respect for workers' rights. It also guarantees that a portion of profits supports community development and sustainable farming practices.

description: Products with this certification meet rigorous environmental, social, and economic criteria that protect forests, conserve wildlife, and support fair treatment and good working conditions for workers. Farms are audited regularly to ensure ongoing compliance.

description: A widely recognized international certification that verifies safe and sustainable agricultural practices. GlobalG.A.P. certification covers food safety, environmental impact, worker health and safety, and animal welfare for farm operations.

description: This certification confirms that the product complies with the European Union’s strict organic farming regulations, including the prohibition of synthetic pesticides and fertilizers, the use of non-GMO seeds, and environmentally friendly farming methods.

name: Certified Carbon Neutral Farm
description: Awarded to farms that have measured, reduced, and offset their greenhouse gas emissions to achieve net-zero carbon output. Certification requires third-party verification and ongoing monitoring of emissions and offsets.

name: Locally Grown Certified
description: This certification verifies that the product was grown, harvested, and processed within a specified radius of the point of sale. It ensures freshness, supports local economies, and reduces transportation-related environmental impacts.

name: Certified Biodynamic Farm
description: This certification is based on the principles of biodynamic agriculture, which integrates holistic, ecological, and ethical approaches to farming. Requirements include biodiversity, crop rotation, use of composts and herbal preparations, and strict prohibition of synthetic inputs.
